user.title: Follow 112 dispatches
user.description: Pick what you want to hear about: a province, safety region, municipality or a point on the map. Leave everything empty and you get the whole of the Netherlands — about 4,000 dispatches a day. Search your own station by name; calls for it always come through, even outside your area. The keyword fields accept * and ?, for example *Epe*.
